description: Gets up to 5 jobs from Remotejobb.se by id: the full description (when the source allows it), salary, employment details, apply link and application deadline (apply_by). apply_method is "email" when applications are sent by email; apply_url then links to the job page on Remotejobb.se instead of opening an email app. Ids that are not available are listed in not_found. With with_similar, each job also lists up to 5 other open jobs in the same category. Ids come from search_jobs.

ids.description: Job ids, as returned by search_jobs (1 to 5). With more than one job, each description is shortened to 3000 characters.

language.description: Language for labels such as work mode and employment type. Job content is returned in its original language.

with_similar.description: Also return up to 5 other open jobs in the same category for each job.

name: get_job
title: Get job details
